notes: Module is fixed to 193.7 THz. Nominal wavelength is stated as 193.7 THz only (no nm values printed). Operating temperature +15°C to +75°C; footnote: cold start from ambient as low as -5°C with specifications after self-heating to minimum operating temperature. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. If TX power is not provisioned by host, module defaults to maximum available power anywhere in the stated 10 dB TX range. CMIS application codes 1, 3, and 4 are not interoperable with OpenZR+ MSA (enhanced media-side optical performance). Rx sensitivity per application mode: -22 dBm (modes 1, 3, 4), -20 dBm (mode 2). CDC range stated as 2 400 ps/nm for all listed application modes. Absolute maximum conditions: Rx signal input power +13 dBm; Rx total input power +15 dBm. Generic definitions state receiver minimum input power is normally at BER 1E-12 but BER is not specified in the application optical table. Ordering latency: 400G CFEC 8 us; 400G OFEC 5 us.
suggestions: Datasheet does not state emitter/photodetector types, Rx OSNR thresholds, LOS deassert, or penalty columns with @ notation; wavelength values in nm are not printed despite fixed 193.7 THz.
